changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' and 'Dialogue Generation' as they are only mentioned as examples of NLG tasks but not actually studied in this paper. Kept only the story generation task that is actually evaluated. Consolidated model names to consistent format.
Normalized all BLEU variants to 'BLEU' and Distinct variants to 'Distinct' following simplification guidelines. The paper uses BLEU-1 and Reverse-BLEU-1 variants, but they are all BLEU-based metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics and human evaluation.

guideline: Preference judgment (win/lose/tie) for relevance and coherence

changes_made.explanation: Added clearer description of the human evaluation methodology. The criteria were correctly extracted.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on long text/story generation using a topic-aware discrete latent variable model. It evaluates on story generation datasets using both automatic metrics (BLEU variants and Distinct) and human evaluation (pairwise comparisons for relevance and coherence). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and removal of tasks that were mentioned but not actually studied.
